# Kashish Gada

> AI engineering intern and computer science student based in Berlin, Germany.

## About

Kashish Gada works on AI software engineering, LLM integration, developer tooling, automated workflows, process optimization, and practical software systems. He is currently an AI Engineering & Research Intern at Voicari GmbH and studies Computer Science at IU Internationale Hochschule.

## Skills

- LLM integration and APIs
- Prompt engineering
- Agentic workflows
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and Bootstrap
- Developer tooling, Git/GitHub, Agile development, research, and process optimization

## Experience

- AI Engineering & Research Intern at Voicari GmbH
- Vice-President of Events and Projects
- Operations Associate at Flink GmbH
- IT & Process Optimization Analyst at Galaxy

## Projects

The portfolio includes work on electronics product pages, a diary application, a log analyzer specification, a space news website, an e-commerce platform, and collaborative learning research.
